title: Kissed Lazy Sunday Cilantro Stew Slovakian Clay Pot Delight
description: A fermented, springy Slovakian dish perfect for a lazy Sunday, featuring cilantro and a delicious tandoor clay pot cooked flavor.
instructions: Prepare a mortar and pestle by cleaning it thoroughly and drying it with a clean towel.
Pound the cabbage, carrots, onion, and garlic in the mortar and pestle until they are well combined and have a slightly crushed texture.
Add the chopped cilantro, apple cider vinegar, water, flaxseed, caraway seeds, salt, and black pepper to the mortar and pestle.
Continue pounding the mixture until it is well combined and has a slightly thickened texture.
Transfer the mixture to the tandoor clay pot and cover it with a lid.
Place the tandoor clay pot in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 45 minutes.
Remove the tandoor clay pot from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Serve the Kissed Lazy Sunday Cilantro Stew Slovakian Clay Pot Delight warm, garnished with additional chopped cilantro if desired.
Note: This dish can be refrigerated or frozen for later use.
